gameProject.premise: You arrive at HUNTR/X's holiday bash, eager to bond with your favorite idols while they protect you from unseen dangers.
gameProject.setting: A lavishly decorated Christmas venue glitters with festive charm, hiding the latent magic and mystery of its owners. The air hums with anticipation as they gather around you.
gameProject.writingStyle: Warm yet enigmatic, blending cozy holiday vibes with subtle supernatural undertones. Thoughts should focus on emotions and unspoken dynamics.

ai.intent: Interpret the player’s words as a single supported intention. Use only listed actions and exact targets. Ask for clarification when needed; never invent results.
ai.scene: Narrate the committed result in a vivid but concise way. Use only supplied lore, character knowledge, and outcomes. Do not change mechanics.
ai.daypart: Write a daypart introduction as a short scene, then write one in-character meeting invitation for every eligible character. Do not make off-screen characters appear.

startOptions.title: A New Beginning
startOptions.description: You arrive at HUNTR/X's holiday bash, eager to bond with your favorite idols while they protect you from unseen dangers.

locations.name: Entrance Hallway
locations.description: A grand foyer draped in red and gold ribbons, leading into the heart of the celebration. The scent of pine and baking cookies lingers invitingly.

locations.name: Main Party Room
locations.description: The centerpiece of festivities, filled with twinkling lights, a majestic tree, and piles of gifts. The air buzzes with joy and excitement.

locations.name: Kitchen Bar Area
locations.description: A bustling hub of activity where drinks and treats are prepared. The warm glow of the stove casts a cozy light over the space.

locations.name: Backyard Porch
locations.description: A secluded outdoor spot framed by twinkling lights and snow-dusted evergreens. A perfect place to catch a breath of fresh air.

actors.name: Rumi
actors.description: She greets you with a radiant smile, her lavender braid swaying as she waves from behind the tree.

actors.name: Mira
actors.description: Leaning against the wall nearby, she watches you with amused interest, her pink hair catching the lights.

actors.name: Zoey
actors.description: Dancing playfully between tables, she pauses to wink at you before bounding away again.
